initial:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Deliver exactly ONE finished landscape 16:9 game Home screen concept for SoloGym, 2048x1152 if available. Full flat screen, no device frame, no contact sheet, no annotations. This image is the visual target for a real Unity fantasy fitness app.

References:
Image 1 (earlier Home concept) is a reference for the cozy medieval gym materials, warm atmosphere and fantasy setting. Redesign its UI to remove the large dashboard column and oversized full-width boxed navigation.
Image 2 (user-authored Barbarian) is the character identity/outfit reference. Preserve the male medium build, natural soft belly, face, curly brown hair and beard, asymmetrical white-fur shoulder with dragon clasp, red short training bottoms, bracers and boots. Show him front-facing, full body, standing naturally. Do not muscularize him, replace his costume or change his palette. This is only a screen mockup, not a new production character.

Art direction:
Premium crafted 16-bit-inspired pixel-art RPG game screen. Cohesive visible square pixel clusters, restrained colors and excellent silhouettes. Rich but readable, with convincing timber, slate masonry, oxblood cloth and antique brass. Deep indigo evening outside and warm amber lanterns inside. Ivory pixel lettering. No smooth vector/web styling, no soft rounded SaaS cards, no giant blank panels, no wall of dialog boxes, no washed-out gray UI.

Composition:
The personal home gym occupies almost the entire screen. Spacious, charming medieval training refuge viewed from a slightly elevated front three-quarter room camera, while the existing character remains front-facing as a 2D sprite. The hero is the focal point on an oxblood rug slightly left of center, about 45% of screen height. Clear floor and negative space around his silhouette. Background elements read as individually placeable game objects with distinct boundaries and consistent grounding.
Left background: small practical sparring ring on the FLOOR, four coherent corner posts with horizontal ropes.
Far left: ONE red leather punching bag hanging from a sturdy ceiling beam OUTSIDE the ring, not on its ropes.
Left foreground: a low timber bench and a simple weight rack with only three clearly separated pairs of matching dumbbells. Each dumbbell has exactly one visible straight handle with a weight at each end, with clear gaps between pairs. No gloves on the bench.
Rear center: a stone arched window showing a distant fantasy castle at blue twilight, a warm hanging lantern.
Right background: compact bed, one storage chest and a small desk with an open book. Restrained plants and banners. Avoid clutter. Keep lower-right floor space usable for the workout action. No enemies, no random extra heroes, no weapons pile.

Interface, integrated as a sparse mobile game HUD:
- Upper-left, one SMALL wood-and-brass title plaque: "MI REFUGIO". It occupies about 17% of screen width, not a giant header.
- Upper-right, one compact hero HUD: a tiny portrait matching reference 2, the text "Aventurero" and below "Nivel 3". A separate small gear icon beside it. No extra stat cards, currency shop, streaks or graphs.
- Lower-right, above the bottom navigation line, one compact quest/action treatment occupying about 28% width and 18% height: short live-text-like ivory labels "RUTINA DE HOY" and "Cuerpo completo · 25 min", followed by ONE clear forest-teal pixel button with slim antique-brass corners reading "ENTRENAR". This should feel like an RPG quest action, not a tall dashboard card. No thumbnail inside it and no second call to action.
- Bottom center, a COMPACT floating navigation dock roughly 50% of the screen width and 9% of height. Four small icon-and-label tabs joined into one low-profile dark-stone strip with fine brass edging. Labels exactly: "Hogar", "Rutinas", "Mazmorra", "Ayuno". Use a tiny house, training dumbbell, dungeon gate, and simple timer icon respectively. "Hogar" is selected with a modest teal inset and warm ivory icon; the others are quieter. This mockup represents an adult who enabled the optional fasting area. No giant full-width button row.
- Bottom-left, a small furniture/hammer icon with the short text "Decorar", subtly grounded in the HUD. No large enclosing panel.
No profile/age test selector, no developer/test labels, no lorem ipsum, no dialog overlays.
Keep controls clearly readable at landscape phone size, with generous screen-edge safe margins and no overlap with the hero, props or one another. Render exact Spanish text cleanly. Make the result feel like entering a beautiful playable personal refuge, with the room and character dominant and the interface secondary.
refinement:
Edit this exact Home screen mockup with one targeted spatial correction. Preserve the entire interface, all Spanish text, typography, palette, character identity/body/outfit/pose/position, rug, window, bed, chest, desk, bench, weight rack and overall composition.

Correct ONLY the gym equipment arrangement in the upper-left quadrant: the punching bag currently appears to hang over the ring platform. Make the ring slightly narrower and set back, with its left boundary farther right, leaving a clear stone-floor training bay at the far left. Hang the existing single red punching bag from its ceiling chain in that separate bay, visibly OUTSIDE the ring ropes and OUTSIDE the raised wooden ring platform footprint. Its bottom hangs above the exposed stone floor. Keep ring geometry coherent: four corner posts with connecting ropes. Neither bag nor chain attaches to ring ropes. Keep the existing weight rack in the foreground separated from the bag, with no merged objects. Do not add another bag, another character, dialog boxes, callouts, equipment or labels. Preserve crisp detailed 16-bit-inspired pixel clusters, 16:9 landscape size, and all unaffected pixels as closely as possible.
